ios.desc:
kingbit is a turn-based strategy game inspired by chess—but designed for fast, tactical fun.

No chess experience? No problem. You can learn kingbit in just 2 minutes!

• Unique Tactics: Each piece has a different size, move range, and attack
• Deep Strategy: Every piece has a purpose; every move and attack matters
• Casual Pace: Strategy unfolds naturally—no memorized openings required
• Quick Matches: 5-10 minute games, perfect for a quick coffee break
• Play Your Way: Face off online, challenge clever AI bots, or use Pass-N-Play for in-person duels

Whether you're a chess fan looking for something new or just love tactical games, kingbit is sure to deliver deep strategy and quick thrills!

quotes.text:
Download Link: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1565583669

"kingbit" combines two of my favourite games: The Nightfall Incident and chess. I usually describe it to people by telling them: "it's like chess, but the pieces can take up multiple squares"

The game is quick to learn and quick to play... a full match is about 5-10 minutes.

If you like "Really Bad Chess", "Pawnbarian" or "Hero Academy" (RIP), I think you'll really enjoy it.

You can see an example of some game play here: https://v.redd.it/6i08fjezl5la1

And you can learn more about the game here: https://old.reddit.com/r/kingbit/

Excited for you try it out! And more excited to play some of you (Game Center: emehex)
